verdict.rationale: The firm publishes an entrepreneur-visa blog post. It walks through an O-1 scenario where a founder can both work in and direct their own business, and it notes the E-2 lets an investor manage and control the business. That touches the core idea of a startup sponsoring its founder, but only at a glancing level. Missing for 10: beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer-control arrangements, the employer-employee relationship for self-petitioning startups, the 2023+ USCIS founder/entrepreneur guidance, and any independent corroboration.
